scientific_integrity: The sharp algebraic value and complete equality class are analytically derived. Numerical checks are supporting only; historical originality is a qualified evidence assessment, not a uniqueness certificate.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the third Taylor coefficient of analytic H^(1/2); depends on Brevig-Søvik arXiv:2610.21788v1, Corollary 3; Suffridge (1990) not fully accessible for historical priority comparison. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Exact third Hardy coefficient at exponent one-half, with rigid quartic optimizers
